name: Side 'n blind Samobor 2023

venue.name: [Osnovna škola Samobor](http://os-samobor.skole.hr/)
venue.details: Competition will be held in the school dining hall. / Natjecanje će biti održano u blagavaonici škole.

information:
(HR)

Side 'n Blind Samobor 2023 jednodnevno je natjecanje na kojemu se održavaju discipline naslijepo i ostale sporedne discipline. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Ukoliko želite sudjelovati na ovom natjecanju, imajte na umu kako se klasične discipline poput 3x3 i 2x2 kocke NE ODRŽAVAJU na ovom natjecanju.

--------------

(EN)

Side 'n Blind Samobor 2023 is a one day competition which holds blind and other side events. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

If you wish to compete in this competition, keep in mind that classic events such as 3x3 and 2x2 cube are NOT HELD at this competition.
